senses.gloss:
मोच मोच, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. मुच्), Mo-
ringa Pterygosperma; (probably) the plantain tree,
Musa Sapientum; (आ), f. Musa Sapientum (= क-
दली, रम्भा); the cotton shrub; the indigo plant;
(ई), f. Hingtscha Repens [cf. हिल-मोची]; (अम्), n. a
plantain, banana (the fruit).
—मोच-निर्यास or मो-
च-रस or मोच-सार or मोच-स्राव, अस्, or मोच-
स्रुत्, त्, m. the resin of Gossampinus Ramphii.

मोचक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. Caus. of rt. 2. मुच्),
liberating, emancipating; (अस्), m. a liberator, one
who has abandoned all worldly passion and desire,
an ascetic, devotee; Moringa Pterygosperma; the
plantain tree, Musa Sapientum; (इका), f. Musa
Sapientum.

मोचन, अस्, ई, अम्, releasing, freeing from;
casting, darting; (ई), f. a species of plant, = कण्ट-
कारी; (अम्), n. the act of releasing, liberating,
liberation, emancipation, setting free, loosing, (ऋण-
[]
मोचन, the releasing from a debt, paying a debt
for any one); the act of unyoking, unharnessing;
letting loose, discharging, emitting.
—मोचन-पट्-
टक, ‘clearing-cloth,’ a filter.

मोचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be released or set free,
to be let loose; to be resigned or given up.

मोचयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set free or re-
leased, (sometimes with inst. of the thing from which
there is release); capable of being set at liberty.

मोचयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, freeing, setting free, re-
leasing.

मोचयित्वा, ind. having freed or loosed, having
unharnessed.

मोचाट, अस्, m. the pith or heart of the banana
tree; the fruit of the banana; a kind of pungent
seed, Nigella Indica; sandal-wood.

मोचित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be released, set at
liberty, emancipated.
मोचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, setting free, liberating.

मोच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set free or released; to
be given up or restored.

मोचिक मोचिक, अस्, m. a leather manu-
facturer, shoe-maker, &c.; [cf. Hindī موچي]
